core_obligations: Exactness (proof lines 5106-5111): to see that the right adjoint defines a morphism of sites one has to check that the associated functor on sheaves is exact, and since it agrees with the pullback of the given morphism of topoi this follows because that is a morphism of topoi.
Identification (proof lines 5112-5113): the pullbacks agree, hence the morphisms of topoi are equal.
proof_roadmap: Check exactness of the functor induced by the right adjoint.
Identify it with the pullback of the given morphism of topoi.
Conclude that the two morphisms of topoi are equal.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if in the situation of the companion result the right adjoint is in addition continuous, then it defines a morphism of sites whose associated morphism of topoi is the given one (statement lines 5096-5102). The proof is short and complete: exactness of the functor induced on sheaves is what has to be checked for a morphism of sites, and it holds because that functor is identified with the pullback of the given morphism of topoi (proof lines 5106-5111); the identification of the pullbacks then gives the equality of the morphisms of topoi (proof lines 5112-5113). The non-formal content is the identification of the two functors. The claim is H1: a short argument with each input named.
